solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Prince of Wales familiarly preceding Her Majesty's horse

indicators.note: preceding says the prince's piece comes first, before the monarch's

parts.note: Chas is the familiar short form of Charles, long the Prince of Wales
ER, Elizabeth Regina, stands for the Queen; the 's is a link

explanation.surface: A royal heir going ahead of the Queen's own racehorse.
explanation.walkthrough: ER is the Queen's royal cipher (Elizabeth Regina).
explanation.definitionFit: A steeplechaser, often shortened in racing talk, is a horse that runs over fences.

clue.text: Chicken helped, we hear, wore a rosette

definitions.note: a verb phrase standing for an adjective meaning sporting a rosette

indicators.note: we hear says the pieces are taken by their sound, not their spelling

parts.note: a cock is a male chicken; aided means helped

explanation.surface: A chicken that lent a hand ends up wearing a show rosette.
explanation.walkthrough: COCK AIDED, said quickly, sounds like the word meaning decked with a cockade; the definition is loose in part of speech.
explanation.definitionFit: A cockade is a rosette or knot of ribbon worn on a hat, so one so adorned is wearing a rosette.

clue.text: A male titan with no limits on lethal danger if knocked back

parts.note: a man is a male person

indicators.note: with no limits means the outer letters of titan are dropped, leaving its middle

explanation.surface: A mighty male figure faces mortal peril if he's brought down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'knocked back' looks like a reversal signal but means swallowed: this mushroom is deadly if eaten.
explanation.definitionFit: Amanita is a genus of mushrooms including the death cap, fatal when eaten.

clue.text: Sociable, lively person unusually Green

parts.note: extra, as in extra large, means beyond the usual
vert is green in heraldry and in French

explanation.surface: An outgoing, bubbly person who is remarkably green, perhaps an eco-campaigner.
explanation.walkthrough: VERT is the heraldic term for green.
explanation.definitionFit: An extravert (or extrovert) is an outgoing, gregarious personality type.

clue.text: Flatterer is one among grown-up men

indicators.note: among says the piece for one sits within the grown-up's letters

parts.note: an adult is a grown-up
a means one
OR, other ranks, means soldiers or men as opposed to officers

explanation.surface: A sycophant moving among adult men.
explanation.walkthrough: OR (other ranks) is a common crossword abbreviation for men.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who adulates heaps excessive praise on another, which is flattery.

clue.text: Very sadly put record on so recently

parts.note: a disc is a gramophone record
lately means recently

explanation.surface: Someone gloomily putting a record on, as they have been doing a lot lately.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting disconsolately means doing so in deep unhappiness, past consolation.

clue.text: Knight sacrificing great deal to get weapon

indicators.note: sacrificing says the knight gives up the piece for a great deal

parts.note: Sir Lancelot is a knight of the Round Table
a lot is a great deal

explanation.surface: A knight forgoes a large fortune to acquire a weapon.
explanation.definitionFit: A lance is a long spear, the knight's jousting weapon.

clue.text: More to be broadcast after article's proposition

indicators.note: after places the scrambled piece behind the article

parts.note: the is the definite article; the 's is a link

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered, so the letters of More are scattered into a new order

explanation.surface: More of something is to go out on air after a newspaper article's proposal.
explanation.definitionFit: A theorem is a proposition in mathematics or logic to be proved.

clue.text: Feel bitter about gift with top missing

indicators.note: in a down entry the top is the first letter, which is taken away here

parts.note: a present is a gift

explanation.surface: Resenting a present that came without its lid.
explanation.definitionFit: To resent something is to feel aggrieved and bitter about it.

clue.text: Logical dilemmas of Buddhist over small bit of text — it is written up after party

indicators.note: after says the reversed piece follows the party

parts.note: Zen is a school of Buddhism
O is the cricket abbreviation for over
para, short for paragraph, is a bit of text
a do is a party

indicators.note: in a down entry, written up means read from the bottom, backwards

parts.note: it is a slang word for sex appeal

explanation.surface: Puzzling logic problems in a Buddhist text, written up after a party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is' is a link; 'it' as sex appeal gives SEX, reversed by 'written up'.
explanation.definitionFit: Zeno of Elea posed paradoxes, such as Achilles and the tortoise, that are famous logical puzzles.

clue.text: She sings about Chinese hair

parts.note: C, for circa, means about
the Han are the majority Chinese people
a tress is a lock of hair

explanation.surface: A female singer is singing about Chinese hair.
explanation.definitionFit: A chantress is an old word for a female singer, from chant.

clue.text: Requirements of river running from south to north, and east to west

indicators.note: in an across entry, east to west means read right to left, backwards

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Wales, England and Scotland

explanation.surface: What a river needs, flowing northwards and then westwards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'running from south to north' sets the river between S and N; 'east to west' then turns the whole lot round.
explanation.definitionFit: Needs are the things one requires, so the plural noun matches requirements.

clue.text: Soul to play in a lively manner

definitions.note: an instruction phrase standing for the musical direction word

parts.note: anima is Latin and Jungian for the soul

explanation.surface: Someone's spirit moved to perform with energy.
explanation.definitionFit: Animato is an Italian score marking telling musicians to perform in an animated way.

clue.text: OR to go too far?

parts.note: in cricket scoring O stands for over and R for run, so the full words give these two letters when abbreviated

explanation.surface: Asking whether 'or' means to exceed limits.
explanation.walkthrough: A reverse clue: the answer split in two gives words whose cricket abbreviations are O and R, which together make the clue's OR.
explanation.definitionFit: To overrun is to go beyond an allotted limit, such as time or a boundary.

clue.text: Raise the spirits of the dead after beginning of Easter

indicators.note: after places the word for dead behind the opening letter
beginning of means only the first letter of Easter is used

parts.note: late means dead, as in the late king

explanation.surface: Cheering up the departed after Easter morning, a resurrection image.
explanation.definitionFit: To elate someone is to make them happy and buoyant, lifting their mood.

clue.text: Finished lamb — I should get a different meat product

parts.note: past means over or finished
lamb is loosely used for a sheep, here the male one, a ram

explanation.surface: The lamb is all gone, so I'll have to get another kind of meat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a different' signals the answer is a meat other than lamb.
explanation.definitionFit: Pastrami is cured, smoked beef, a deli meat quite unlike lamb.

clue.text: Revolutionary to look about very softly in Cayenne

parts.note: a red is a communist revolutionary

indicators.note: about says the look piece goes round the softly piece

parts.note: to peer is to look closely
pp, pianissimo, is the musical direction for very softly

explanation.surface: A revolutionary quietly looking about in Cayenne, the capital of French Guiana.
explanation.walkthrough: Cayenne looks like the town but is the spice.
explanation.definitionFit: Cayenne is a hot powdered capsicum, a kind of this spicy vegetable.

clue.text: Shopping centre with roof brought down by you twice? Nonsense!

indicators.note: in a down entry the roof is the top letter, here moved to the bottom

parts.note: a mall is a shopping centre

indicators.note: twice means the word for you is written two times

parts.note: ye is an old form of you

explanation.surface: A shopping centre's roof collapsed, all down to you? Rubbish!
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is a dated British exclamation dismissing something as rubbish or humbug.

clue.text: Clergyman's symphony

definitions.meaning: relating to a pastor, the duties of a minister
Beethoven's Sixth Symphony carries this nickname

explanation.surface: A vicar's own symphony.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective covers a pastor's care for his flock, and is also the name of Beethoven's Sixth Symphony.

clue.text: Fish in every spirit

indicators.note: in says the fish sits inside the word for every

parts.note: all means every
the coho is a Pacific salmon

explanation.surface: A fish found in every spirit bottle.
explanation.definitionFit: Spirits such as gin and whisky are strong drinks, the name for their intoxicating content.

clue.text: Live and be a success lacking nothing

indicators.note: lacking says the zero is taken out

parts.note: to do well is to be a success
O is the zero shape for nothing

explanation.surface: Advice to live a successful life without anything.
explanation.definitionFit: To dwell somewhere is to live or reside there.

clue.text: Have a look at love-god — uplifting or ugly sight?

parts.note: to eye something is to look at it

indicators.note: in a down entry, uplifting means the word is turned so it reads upwards

parts.note: Eros is the Greek god of love

explanation.surface: Take a look at a statue of Eros: inspiring, or hideous?
explanation.walkthrough: Eros is also the famous statue at Piccadilly Circus, London.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unpleasant to look at, such as a hideous building, is described this way.

clue.text: Suffer to get out of bed and call to account?

parts.note: to suffer is to undergo or have, as in have a cold
up means out of bed

explanation.surface: Struggling to rise in the morning, then being summoned to explain oneself.
explanation.definitionFit: To bring someone before a court or authority to answer for something is this informal phrasal verb.

clue.text: Charged and doomed? That's not right

indicators.note: not says the right letter is left out of the doomed word

parts.note: accursed means doomed or damned

explanation.surface: Charged with a crime and condemned? That's unjust.
explanation.walkthrough: 'That's not right' reads as a protest but tells you to drop R.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone charged with an offence is the defendant in a criminal case.

clue.text: One locks up gang led by son

indicators.note: led by puts the son's letter at the head, in front of the gang

parts.note: a crew is a gang

explanation.surface: A man who locks up a gang headed by his son.
explanation.walkthrough: A screw is slang for a prison officer.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang for a prison warder, the person who locks the inmates up.

clue.text: Be a mite fussy; it keeps rafters together

indicators.note: fussy suggests fiddling about with the letters of Be a mite until they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Being picky over a tiny thing, with a builder's aside about roof timbers.
explanation.definitionFit: A horizontal timber joining the feet of a pair of rafters to stop them spreading.

clue.text: Number one isn't in also

definitions.note: read as numb-er, something that numbs

indicators.note: isn't in says the letter for one is no longer there

parts.note: either is used as also in negatives, as in I can't either
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A puzzle about whether number one is also in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Number' is not a figure but a thing that numbs, an anaesthetic.
explanation.definitionFit: Diethyl ether was an early anaesthetic, a substance that deadens sensation.

clue.text: Axes cut and perfect this instrument

parts.note: x and y are the axes of a graph
to lop is to cut
to hone is to sharpen and perfect

explanation.surface: Cutting and sharpening axes for making a musical instrument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Axes' looks like choppers, which suits 'cut', but means graph axes.
explanation.definitionFit: A percussion instrument of wooden bars struck with mallets.

clue.text: Ewe's pail must be positioned vertically

indicators.note: must be positioned tells you to arrange these letters in a new place and order

explanation.surface: A milking pail for ewes must stand upright.
explanation.walkthrough: PALEWISE is a heraldic term: arranged like the pale, a vertical band.
explanation.definitionFit: In heraldry, charges set upright in the direction of the pale stripe are said to lie this way.

clue.text: Stop to liberate worthless person? Not right one initially

parts.note: to free is to liberate

indicators.note: Not says the following letters are taken away

parts.note: a zero is a nobody, a worthless person

indicators.note: initially means the first letters of right and one

explanation.surface: Halt in order to release a good-for-nothing? Not the right one at first.
explanation.definitionFit: To freeze is to stop dead and stay still.
